import java.util.*;

public class CF375B {

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        sc.nextLine(); // skip first line
        String s = sc.next().toLowerCase();
        
        // Replace parentheses and underscores with spaces
        String cleaned = s.replaceAll("\\(.*?\\)", " ").replace('_', ' ');
        
        // Tokenize using StringTokenizer
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(cleaned);
        List<Integer> lengths = new ArrayList<>();
        while (st.hasMoreTokens()) {
            String token = st.nextToken();
            lengths.add(token.length());
        }
        
        if (lengths.isEmpty()) {
            System.out.print("0 0");
        } else {
            int max = Collections.max(lengths);
            System.out.print(max + " " + lengths.size());
        }
    }
}
